# Do You Love Me? Yes or No Love Prank (Raxzen)

> Official Website: https://rafidmondal.github.io/Love-Yes-or-No-website/
> Creator: Raxzen | Location: India | Last update: This month

## Summary
Do You Love Me? Yes or No Love Prank by Raxzen is a playful, interactive browser prank game designed to share with a crush, partner, or friends. When opened, the screen asks "Do you love me?" with a Yes button and a playful No button that runs away whenever someone tries to tap or hover over it.

## Key Features
- **Runaway "No" Button**: Playful dodging animation makes it funny and memorable when shared.
- **Celebration Result Screen**: Tapping "Yes" leads to a sweet animated result screen (`index2.html`).
- **One-Tap Sharing**: Built-in Share and Copy Link buttons for WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and messages.
- **Mobile & Low-RAM Friendly**: Lightweight HTML5/CSS/JS with adaptive performance for smooth play on any phone.
- **PWA Support**: Installable web app experience.
